title: Be accredited to operate a bus service
what: Hold an operator accreditation before operating a passenger transport service.

sources.title: Passenger Transport Act 1994 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a passenger transport service within (or partly within) the State unless the person holds an appropriate accreditation for that service under this Division.
